claims.text: Regime: probe.py in this folder, offline, no LLM. 30 ArchitectureIQ dataset instances from the external checkout learned one per round in 5 random orders; CPPN rows also span 5 initialisation seeds. new_acc is pair accuracy on an instance before it is learned. Small data: 30 instances and 410 candidates, so these describe this set only. Claim, the gate for wiring a CPPN into the loop, which the author expects to fail because nearest neighbours won in earlier tests: even with full replay, a CPPN predicts new instances at least 2 points better than nearest neighbours; a difference <= 0 falsifies.

Claim, the premise: a CPPN updated without replay forgets, losing at least 0.05 of pair accuracy on learned instances by the end; <= 0.02 falsifies.
